tldr: Venus in the 10th house routes love and value through public contribution.
body: With Venus in the 10th house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through career, public role, reputation, authority, and legacy. This makes how you become visible, take responsibility, and build a life that can be recognized a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through public contribution.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in public contribution.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
